# EffeTune documentation snapshot (Japanese)

- Source: https://github.com/Frieve-A/effetune (MIT License, see LICENSE in this folder)
- Commit: c506bbab8a3dcd75bc5049ebb9b92572b526c557
- Why this commit: it is the `external/effetune` submodule of EffeTune Mixwright v0.15.0,
  release commit 8c9a0a561d2ee88d2eef6b06bab138bbd639b3c1, the VST3 build bundled with mImageViewer.
- Contents: `docs/i18n/ja/` copied verbatim into `ja/`, plus the 4 referenced images
